cases.description: A synthetic scalar mean resolves exact ordered parents and deterministically recomputes to the declared output.
Mean-radiant temperature is described by the six-direction ISO 7726 method profile, but its input channel is not admitted in v0.1.
Useful thermal energy requires water temperature inputs that remain proposed, not admitted, in channel profile v0.1.
A source digest is present but an exact source input edge is missing.
The same source observation is referenced twice.
The exact input source digest is absent.
The input source alias uses an implicit latest pointer rather than an exact revision.
The input source revision does not match its exact source receipt.
A source observation is stale.
A parent calibration is expired.
A parent installation was relocated and not reverified.
A parent instrument firmware revision was replaced after the source observation.
The source and output timebase clock epochs differ.
Input time windows differ while the method requires exact alignment.
Hidden interpolation is declared even though the method requires exact source observations.
Missing inputs are imputed instead of causing abstention.
The output is relabelled as a raw instrument measurement.
The output method artifact digest is missing.
The method revision is superseded.
The derivation has no distinct calculation-system identity.
The derived output lacks exact geometry revision support.
The input source's data-use rights were revoked.
A parent is another derived result whose graph digest cannot be resolved.
An input references the derived output itself, creating a cycle.
Input ordinals are duplicated.
The ordered selection list does not match the exact input edges.
The method input-contract digest is absent.
The method and calculation runtime identities disagree.
The input unit differs from the exact method input contract.
The input quantity identity differs while the unit happens to match.
The input timebase profile is missing.
The uncertainty model reference is missing.
The declared result cannot be reproduced from the frozen input values.
The same derivation ID is used with a conflicting graph revision.
The source-resolution receipt is incomplete.
The method claims a physical result while its output is a synthetic-only fixture.
The output window clock epoch differs from the exact source stream epoch.
The output window tick unit differs from the source stream tick unit.
A nested derived parent is cited with a graph digest but omitted from the resolution receipt.
The source-resolution receipt lists the parent but binds a different graph digest.
